The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 30, 2025, approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement (the "Scheme") involving the merger of Anchemco India Private Limited (a fellow subsidiary) with Asia Investments Private Limited (the Immediate Holding Company) on a going concern basis with effect from the Appointed Date of April 1, 2025, and the subsequent demerger and transfer of the Automotive Undertaking (as defined in the Scheme) of Asia Investments Private Limited to the Company with effect from the Appointed Date of April 1, 2026. The Scheme was approved by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) vide its order dated May 11, 2026. Accordingly, during the half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has given effect to the Scheme using the pooling of interest method, applied retrospectively for all periods and year ended March 31, 2026, presented in the standalone financial results, as prescribed under Ind AS 103 – "Business Combinations", and the figures for the previous periods have been restated accordingly. The restated results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, half year ended September 30, 2025 and the quarter ended March 31, 2026, have, to the extent of the Automotive Undertaking included therein, neither been subjected to limited review and such figures have been furnished by the management of the Company, which has exercised necessary due diligence to ensure that these financial results present a true and fair view of the Company's affairs.

On July 21, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company approved acquisition of 28.99% equity stake on HL Mando Anand India Private Limited equivalent to 48,134,427 equity shares from Asia Investments Private Limited (Promoter and holding company of the Company), for a composite consideration of Rs.22,310 millions which was approved by the shareholder on August 19, 2026. The Consideration was discharged by issue of 1,44,04,204 equity shares at aggregating to Rs. 18,810 million to the Promoter on preferential basis and balance Rs. 3,500 millions was paid in cash. The preferential allotment of securities was done on September 11, 2026 which was considered as the date of acquisition by the management. The Company has accounted the acquisition at fair value in accordance with IND AS 28 "Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures".

On July 21, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company had accorded its approval for execution of Share Purchase Agreement and Joint Venture Agreements ('Agreements') with HL Klemove Corporation and HL Klemove India Private Limited ('the "Target Company'), purchasing 37,844,999 equity shares of the Target Company at a consideration of USD 98.44 million. The Company has acquired the shares on August 25, 2026 and has been considered as date of acquisition. The Company has accounted the acquisition at fair value in accordance with IND AS 28 "Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures".
